title: BCD to decimal decoder/driver with open-collector outputs

sources.document: TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, section 7 (MSI/LSI data sheets)

functions.formula: 0 = NOT (D' AND C' AND B' AND A')
functions.text: Output 0 is low (on, transistor sinking) only when DCBA = 0000; inputs 10-15 leave every output high.

functions.formula: 1 = NOT (D' AND C' AND B' AND A)
functions.text: Output 1 is low (on, transistor sinking) only when DCBA = 0001; inputs 10-15 leave every output high.

functions.text: Output 2 is low (on, transistor sinking) only when DCBA = 0010; inputs 10-15 leave every output high.

functions.text: Output 3 is low (on, transistor sinking) only when DCBA = 0011; inputs 10-15 leave every output high.

functions.text: Output 8 is low (on, transistor sinking) only when DCBA = 1000; inputs 10-15 leave every output high.

timing.conditions: VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 100 ohm
VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 100 ohm

electrical.notes: Open-collector, 30 V off-state output voltage (recommended operating conditions). Sinks up to 80 mA per output (description; VO(on) max 0.9 V at 80 mA, 0.4 V at 20 mA). Off-state leakage max 250 uA at 30 V. Lamp, relay or MOS driver.

unknown: Typical propagation delays: the table gives maximum only.
IOL is not in the recommended-operating-conditions table; 80 mA is the figure from the description and the VO(on) test condition.
IOH as a source current does not apply (open collector); outputHighMaxCurrentMa is null.
notes: The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delays; the path-delay function uses 0 ns for the minimum.
